system.description:
| Dust Veil – Volatile / Max Rank: 5, [Physical], [Elemental] / A Volatile creature is covered in extremely explosive carbon dust for the next minute. / If a Volatile creature takes fire or lightning damage, the carbon dust sparks and then explodes. When it does, all creatures within 5-feet of the exploding creature take 1d12 fire damage for every rank of Volatile that was detonated, then removing all ranks of Volatile. / A creature can only take damage from one Instance of a Volatile explosion. / A Creature that takes cold damage as a result of a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, submerges themselves in a body of water, or spend 1 action on their turns can cleanse itself of the Volatile condition. |

You can manipulate particles of jagged iron dust, sharp and durable. While your Dust Veil is active, you radiate a 10-foot aura of floating serrated iron particles. Creatures of your choice that cast a jutsu with the Mobility (M) component while within this aura must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, if they have ranks of Bleed already, they suffer the effects of the Bleed condition as if it was the beginning of their turn.

Potency I: Once per turn, When a creature fails a saving throw against a Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast, they gain a rank of Bleed.

Potency II: You can spend 10 minutes coating your Iron Particles in a Poison you have access to. When you do, until you complete a rest, when you force a saving throw with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu or with the Potency I effect of this particle type, creatures who fail their saving throw can suffer the effects of the chosen poison you coated your particles in, in place of the original Jutsu’s effect or your Potency I effect (your choice). If you could coat your particles in a different poison, the previous poison becomes inert.

| Dust Veil – Heavy / [Physical], [Elemental] / A Heavy creature cannot jump or benefit from the Dash or Disengage actions. / A Heavy creature suffers disadvantage on the first Dexterity saving throw they make each turn. / A Heavy creature treats spends 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot moved. |
